skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding Legal Indicators and Punishments for Crimes
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand legal indicators and punishments for crimes in Vietnam's Criminal Code.
Analyze specific behaviors to determine if they constitute crimes and confirm the principle of determining punishment for offenders.
Apply communication and presentation skills effectively.
Apply problem-solving skills to legal issues related to crimes and punishments.
Develop the ability to independently research, accumulate, and enhance specialized knowledge in criminal law.
